name: Dagger
description: A simple blade weapon used for close combat.

name: Shortsword
description: A martial melee weapon with a short blade.

name: Longsword
description: A martial melee weapon with a long blade.

name: Greatsword
description: A large two-handed blade.

name: Greataxe
description: A massive two-handed axe.

name: Shortbow
description: A simple ranged weapon.

name: Longbow
description: A martial ranged weapon with extended range.

name: Leather Armor
description: Light armor made from softened and flexible leather.

name: Chain Mail
description: Heavy armor made of interlocking metal rings.

name: Plate Armor
description: Heavy armor consisting of shaped, interlocking metal plates.

name: Shield
description: A shield provides +2 to AC.

name: Longsword +1
description: A magically enhanced longsword that provides a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls.

name: Flame Tongue
description: You can use a bonus action to speak this magic sword's command word, causing flames to erupt from the blade. These flames shed bright light in a 40-foot radius and dim light for an additional 40 feet. While the sword is ablaze, it deals an extra 2d6 fire damage to any target it hits.

effects.description: Deals an extra 2d6 fire damage when activated

name: Vorpal Sword
description: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, the weapon ignores resistance to slashing damage. When you attack a creature that has at least one head with this weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, you cut off one of the creature's heads.

effects.description: Ignores resistance to slashing damage. On natural 20, severs head of creature with heads.

name: Armor +1
description: You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.

name: Cloak of Protection
description: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while you wear this cloak.

name: Ring of Protection
description: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while wearing this ring.

name: Ring of Invisibility
description: While wearing this ring, you can turn invisible as an action. Anything you are wearing or carrying is invisible with you. You remain invisible until the ring is removed, until you attack or cast a spell, or until you use a bonus action to become visible again.

effects.description: Can turn invisible as an action

name: Belt of Giant Strength (Hill)
description: While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 21. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than the belt's score, the item has no effect on you.

name: Potion of Healing
description: You regain 2d4 + 2 hit points when you drink this potion.

name: Potion of Greater Healing
description: You regain 4d4 + 4 hit points when you drink this potion.

name: Potion of Superior Healing
description: You regain 8d4 + 8 hit points when you drink this potion.

name: Potion of Fire Resistance
description: When you drink this potion, you gain resistance to fire damage for 1 hour.

name: Cursed Sword of Vengeance
description: This sword appears to be a +1 longsword. However, once you attune to it, you are cursed until you are targeted by remove curse. While cursed, you are unwilling to part with the sword, keeping it within reach at all times. You also have disadvantage on attack rolls with weapons other than this one.

curse.description: Cursed - unwilling to part with sword
curse.effect: Disadvantage on attacks with other weapons. Cannot voluntarily remove sword.

name: Armor of Vulnerability
description: While wearing this armor, you have resistance to one of the following damage types: bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing. However, you have vulnerability to the other two types. Once you don the armor, you can't doff it unless you are targeted by remove curse or similar magic.

curse.effect: Resistance to one physical damage type, vulnerability to the other two. Cannot remove without Remove Curse.

name: Scroll of Fireball
description: A spell scroll containing the fireball spell (3rd level).

name: Bag of Holding
description: This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions. The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. The bag weighs 15 pounds, regardless of its contents.

effects.description: Can hold 500 lbs of items in extradimensional space
